_comment: OPStack EEST adapter skip list. Documents known divergences from standard Ethereum execution.
_policy: Skip entries that fail due to OPStack fee model or execution path differences. File issues for true OPStack bugs.

_gap_catalog.G1: Fee model divergence — baseFee routed to OP_BASE_FEE_RECIPIENT instead of burned. EEST expects standard Ethereum fee semantics.
_gap_catalog.G2: Nonce tracking — OPStack path does not write sender nonce increment to stateDiff. Nonce is managed externally by the transaction pool.
_gap_catalog.G3: L1Block predeploy storage — EEST fixtures don't include OP_L1_BLOCK_PREDEPLOY, so post-state accounts differ when contract reads L1Block.
_gap_catalog.G4: Precompile behavior difference — OPStack precompile routing differs from evmone built-in precompiles.
_gap_catalog.G5: Gas schedule difference — OPStack intrinsic gas calculation differs from standard Ethereum for certain tx types.
_gap_catalog.G6: Selfdestruct semantics — EIP-6780 selfdestruct behavior may differ between OPStack and standard Ethereum execution paths.
_gap_catalog.G7: Transient storage — EIP-1153 transient storage opcodes may have different behavior in OPStack execution context.
_gap_catalog.G8: Authorization cost — EIP-7702 authorization processing costs may differ in OPStack path.

eip2930_access_list.reason: Fee model divergence: baseFee goes to OP_BASE_FEE_RECIPIENT instead of being burned. Sender balance differs by baseFee*gasUsed.

eip1559.reason: Fee model divergence: baseFee + tip routing differs from EIP-1559 standard. OPStack routes baseFee to OP_BASE_FEE_RECIPIENT.

eip2929_gas.reason: Gas schedule + fee model divergence. OPStack warm/cold gas costs and fee routing differ from standard Ethereum.

eip4844_blobs.reason: Blob fee routing divergence. OPStack handles blob fees differently (separate L1 blob fee path).

eip7702_set_code.reason: Authorization processing + fee model divergence. Nonce and fee routing differences.

eip1153_tstore.reason: Transient storage semantics may differ in OPStack execution context.

eip6780_selfdestruct.reason: Selfdestruct semantics differ between EIP-6780 standard and OPStack execution.

eip2537_bls.reason: BLS precompile behavior difference between evmone and OPStack routing.

eip7623_calldata.reason: Calldata floor gas + fee model divergence. OPStack intrinsic gas calculation differs.

eip7823_modexp.reason: Modexp precompile behavior + fee model divergence.

nonce_mismatch.description: OPStack path does not write nonce to stateDiff. Nonce is managed by tx pool. Skip nonce assertions for known-divergent fixtures.

balance_mismatch_nonzero_l1.description: Balance differences where L1 fee scalars are non-zero or base fee routing differs. Skip balance assertions for coinbase/OP_BASE_FEE_RECIPIENT/OP_L1_FEE_RECIPIENT.
